name: Gallery
description: Display a grid of images with optional captions, with a range of layout options.

caption.description: Caption describing the whole gallery; supports inline phrasing HTML tags such as <em> and <strong>

columns.description: The number of columns to use for the layout (may be overridden to fewer in small containers/viewports)

context.description: The kebab-case or BEM element chain name of the parent component or variant (if contextually relevant).

imageCrop.description: Whether to crop images to fill their grid cells (true) or contain them within their grid cells (false)

shortName.description: The name of the component without any namespacing, prefixes, etc. Used for BEM block/element naming. Derived from the Blade filename if not explicitly set.

tagName.description: The HTML tag to use for this component

testId.description: Optionally add a data-testid attribute for automated tests

innerComponents.description: The image components to display in the gallery
